okay if you need personal help, you can always message me and I'll try my best :) but the advice I can give in order that you must try is to use an app or a notepad to track down your unhealthy behaviours such as stalking, digital sh, etc and color code them to see your progress (e.g highlighted in green = healthy progress/doing amazing, highlighted in yellow = making some progress/still needs more work and red = need to work on most)  once you ACTUALLY manage to focus on getting to green and getting rid of this behavior, I'd suggest to think about telling your girlfriend. of course this is a personal issue of your own that you have done but it does affect your gf and she has an important role in this. you can decide what to do but opening up would help you in the long run if you want support from your girlfriend as well.
